standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Groupoids in Spaces, lemmas quotient-stack-2-coequalizer and quotient-stack-morphisms (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produce f_can and the description of Isom sheaves for parts (5) and (6).

core_obligations: (1): representability of R = U x_{f,X,f} U via the diagonal criterion and the base-change lemma.
(2): the associativity/erase-factor rewriting with the explicit object-level map ((a, b, alpha), c, beta) -> ((a, b, alpha), (b, c, beta)).
(3): pr02 from the triple 2-fibre product lemma, with the object-level description ((a, b, alpha), (b, c, beta)) -> (a, c, beta o alpha).
(4): identify the iterated 2-fibre product with R x_{s,U,t} R through the setoid presheaf correspondence and verify the groupoid axioms on the explicit object descriptions for every T.

(5): build tau: f pr1 -> f pr0 with tau(a,b,alpha) = alpha^{-1}; verify the 2-coequalizer identity by the object-level computation; transfer the data to (S_U, S_R, s, t, c) via the quasi-inverse subcategory trick; obtain f_can: [U/R] -> X from the 2-coequalizer lemma with the explicit morphism formula.

(6): identify both Isom sheaves fppf-locally: the left as R x_{(t,s),UxU,(b,a)} T by the quotient-stack morphisms lemma, the right through the 2-fibre product chain of the Stacks lemma; conclude the induced isomorphism is compatible with the morphism formula.
proof_roadmap: Representability; object-level rewriting; pr02 construction; groupoid axioms; 2-coequalizer with quasi-inverse trick; Isom identification.
difficulty_reason: The chapter's core construction: six interlocking parts with an explicit quasi-inverse subcategory trick and an Isom-sheaf identification; no step is a routine citation.
